sloka: ददर्श हनुमान् देवीम् लतामकुसुमामिव ।सा मलेन च दिग्धाङ्गीवपुषा चाप्यलंकृता ।। ५-१७-२५।।
transliteration: dadarśa hanumān devīm latāmakusumāmiva ।sā malena ca digdhāṅgīvapuṣā cāpyalaṁkṛtā ।। 5-17-25।।

translations.english: Even though she was daubed with dirt, and had no ornaments on her, she looked bright like a lotus fibre smeared with mud.
